description: Gender pay gap reporting: does an employer of a given size have to report, how often, and when a joint pay assessment applies, in the jurisdiction's own words with official sources and dates. For an EU member state the Directive's size bands are listed apart as the baseline addressed to Member States. It does not compute dates the texts do not state. Not for: computing the gap from figures (pay_gap_from_aggregates).

employer_headcount.description: Number of workers (employees) of the employer; the reporting duty depends on company size.

jurisdiction.description: Country, US state or Canadian province code from list_jurisdictions, e.g. AT (Austria), IT (Italy), MT (Malta), PL (Poland), SK (Slovakia), US-CA (California), US-NY (New York), CA-ON (Ontario).

name: gap_reporting_rules
title: Pay-gap reporting rules
